verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a public REST API with a full OpenAPI 3.0 reference and a versioning policy, claims the API can reach "any existing object" in an account, and offers an official MCP server for accessing and managing controls, tests, vendors, frameworks and risks. Nothing in the evidence says every UI action can also be done through the API, and it is unclear whether UI-heavy workflows have API equivalents, such as Trust Center design and request approvals, policy editing, and access review decisions. Missing for 10: an explicit UI–API parity commitment, confirmed write and management coverage for Trust Center, policy and access-review workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API completeness.
